_help: event -> shell command run on the Mac. Events: music.play music.pause music.toggle music.next music.prev music.volume_up music.volume_down camera.enter camera.capture camera.exit camera.exchange find_phone.start find_phone.stop unknown. Use an empty string to ignore an event.
music.volume_up: osascript -e 'set volume output volume ((output volume of (get volume settings)) + 6)'
music.volume_down: osascript -e 'set volume output volume ((output volume of (get volume settings)) - 6)'
camera.enter: osascript -e 'display notification "Shutter button ready" with title "OHW-11 remote"'
find_phone.start: afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff; osascript -e 'display notification "Your watch is looking for this Mac" with title "OHW-11" sound name "Glass"'
